name: Sathrah's Sacrifice
summary: At the Temple of the Moon, Sathrah's Sacrifice gives a fallen creature's spirit a final rite. You carry Lady Sathrah's spinnerets to Elune's sacred waters, where the Priesthood seeks to cleanse her soul of corruption.

sections.title: A Cleansing in Sacred Waters
sections.body: Priestess A'moora asks you to perform a final rite after Lady Sathrah is slain. The great spider fell to the dark madness spreading across Teldrassil, which twisted her peaceful nature into mindless aggression. The Priesthood of Elune seeks to redeem her fallen essence, not treat her death as a simple culling. You place her silvery spinnerets in the fountain at the heart of the Temple of the Moon. Its consecrated waters wash away the corruption and grant her release.

sections.title: The Renewal of Sathrah
sections.body: When the spinnerets touch the moonlit pool, Lady Sathrah's peaceful spirit rises, cleansed of the affliction that drove her mad. The Sisterhood of Elune sees the rite as her salvation. Though the loss of the great creature is deeply felt, night elven belief holds that sacred purification can let her be reborn one day with an uncorrupted spirit.

faq.answer: Lady Sathrah was a great spider who lived on Teldrassil and succumbed to the corruption spreading through the World Tree's wildlife. The taint drove her mad, and she had to be slain so her remains could be sanctified.

aliases: where do i put the sacrifice
faq.answer: You offer the sacrifice in the holy fountain at the center of the Temple of the Moon, the Sisterhood of Elune's central sanctuary in Darnassus.

faq.q: What happens when you place the spinnerets in the fountain?
faq.answer: When you place the silvery spinnerets in the blessed waters, Sathrah's purified spirit appears briefly in the pool and walks freely and peacefully, signaling Elune's acceptance.

faq.q: Why did Lady Sathrah have to die?
faq.answer: The corruption in Lady Sathrah's mind ran too deep to heal while she lived. Priestess A'moora and the Sisterhood believed they could save her soul only by ending her suffering and cleansing her remains in Elune's holy waters.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Sathrah's Sacrifice?
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora gives and concludes Sathrah's Sacrifice from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, overlooking the central chamber.

faq.q: What belief underpins this ritual for the night elves?
faq.answer: Night elves believe souls purified by the Mother Moon can be reborn into the natural world, their spirits renewed and free of corruption.

angles.text: As a night elf, you honor the flora and fauna of Kalimdor through this solemn rite. Even when a creature must be slain, its spirit is honored and cleansed through Elune's grace.
As a priest, you see how Elune's holy light and sacred waters can mend spirits afflicted by madness and corruption.
As a druid, you can find solace in knowing fallen beasts can return to the natural cycle through purification, even as Teldrassil suffers from sickness.
